pytest.scope: Offline synthetic/benign tests from the clean generating checkout

ece_bins: 10 equal-width probability bins; p=1 in last bin
limitations: The new acquired PDF cohort is separate from the historical RIT table; no assumed row-to-PDF match.
Known duplicate hashes, identical feature vectors, and declared related samples are grouped; unknown PDF family relations are not proven absent.
Test contains no parser failures under the saved group-aware split; forced-parser referral is verified by offline tests, not measured on parser-failing Test samples.
Vision uses the predeclared two-epoch CPU training budget; no claim of convergence or exhaustive optimization.
Referrals are abstentions and recommendations only; no dynamic analysis runs or corrected-referral accuracy.
